name: vision_vae_bad
title: The same convolutional VAE with six planted defects
origin: domain-vision round 1: the dirty twin of vision_vae; its composite loss function is what turns the whole train-loop rule family off

expected.defect: the decoder's Sequential ends in nn.Sigmoid while the reconstruction term is still binary_cross_entropy_with_logits
expected.why: the sigmoid is applied twice, so the reconstruction gradient collapses and every sample converges to the dataset mean

expected.defect: the training step never calls optimizer.zero_grad()
expected.why: every update applies the running sum of the epoch's gradients, so the ELBO diverges after a few hundred batches

expected.defect: the training loader does not shuffle
expected.why: CelebA is stored in identity order, so each batch is one face and the posterior collapses to it

expected.defect: the ELBO is accumulated as a live tensor and never reset
expected.why: every batch's autograd graph is retained for the whole run
the decoder's BatchNorm2d layers normalise the 64 noise draws by their own statistics and then keep them, so the next training step starts from statistics learned on noise
expected.gap: sample() loops over nothing and is not a name in MLV301's eval-function regex, so a VAE sampler run in train mode is out of reach.

expected.why: the decoder graph for 64 images is built and dropped on every epoch

expected.defect: the whole module is pickled instead of its state_dict
expected.why: the checkpoint carries the class path and breaks when vae.py moves

forbidden.why: there is no evaluation loader in this project
the loader is built inside build_loader(), reached only from train() under the __main__ guard
optimizer.step() is still called every batch
no backward() call is inside a no_grad region
there is no softmax and no CrossEntropyLoss in this project
the images are still moved to the device and the latent draw is still allocated with device=
there is no split in this project
every nn.Module subclass still calls super().__init__()
every submodule stack is still an nn.Sequential

gaps.what: the KL term is subtracted instead of added, so the optimiser is rewarded for a larger divergence from the prior and the latent space stops being samplable - no rule checks the sign of a variational objective
gaps.evidence: vae.py:124 against the clean twin's + kl_weight * kl

gaps.what: every train-loop rule is silent on this program because the loss comes from elbo(), a function whose return is an arithmetic combination (reconstruction - kl)/N rather than a direct loss call, so the LOSS tag never reaches loss.backward()
gaps.evidence: the MLV201 and MLV205 expected labels above are standing misses; minimal repro in the report
